messages:
zoe: flagging a reproducible issue in the onboarding sample app: embeddings batch returns mixed vector sizes (384 vs 512) when we force an auth refresh mid-request. This breaks rerank downstream.
rahul: thanks — which sample app / SDK? can you share repro steps?
zoe: node sampleapp using axios + keepAlive Agent. Steps: send batch of 6 items to /embeddings, expire token after first chunk, let SDK refresh and retry. Intermittently one item in returned "data" has 384 floats while rest are 512.
nick: that suggests socket/stream interleaving on retry. If the initial response stream isn't fully drained before the connection is reassigned, leftover bytes from the previous response could be parsed into the new one.
zoe: exact raw snippet (dims only): {"data":[{"id":0,"len":512},{"id":1,"len":384},{"id":2,"len":512}],"model":"redwood-embed-1"}
rahul: server-side note: runtime assumes a model fixed-dim, but we should add a defensive check. If a response contains inconsistent embedding lengths, return a diagnostic error instead of silently passing bad vectors.
nick: short-term mitigation in SDK: validate every embedding length == model_dim, otherwise raise EmbeddingShapeError and drop the batch. Also instrument a telemetry event "mixed_embedding_size".
zoe: I opened node-sdk#312 with shape check + added a retry-path change: when auth refresh happens, set Agent.keepAlive=false for the retried request so the socket won't be reused.
rahul: good. Also update batching helper to reset streaming parser state between retries to avoid carryover.
nick: for a longer fix, runtime should also include a response header with expected-dim so clients can sanity-check before parsing. Could help obscure clients too.
ci-bot: CI queued: node-sdk/shape-guard (#312) job 9012
zoe: after applying shape-guard + disabling keepAlive on retry, local e2e (200 iters forcing expiry) showed 0 mixed-size returns. We'll run upstream tests after CI.
rahul: file runtime issue: RT#9902 (validate embedding lengths per-response). We'll coordinate server-side change separately.
nick: thanks all. once CI passes, let's push a small troubleshooting blurb in the onboarding docs explaining this failure mode and recommending SDK upgrade.
zoe: adding note in docs and will paste the quick repro script in #devex for folks to try locally.
rahul: closing loop once runtime PR is opened. cheers.
